items.title: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
items.summary: The Institute of Foundation Models at MBZUAI released PAN 2, an Apache 2.0 world model that couples an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate up to 20 seconds of action outcomes as video. The post MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Fish Audio Releases Live 3, a Full-Duplex Voice Model That Reacts in 186 ms
items.summary: Fish Audio released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model for voice agents. It listens while it speaks, separates “mm-hmm” from real interruptions, and can react in as little as 186 ms. English only at launch The post Fish Audio Releases Live 3, a Full-Duplex Voice Model That Reacts in 186 ms appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs
items.summary: Meta FAIR’s e-means is a mini-batch k-means replacement shipped in FAISS 1.16.0. It reaches Lloyd’s 25-epoch loss in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, with 10-45x GPU speedups and no extra hyperparameters. The post Meta FAIR Releases e-means: An Algorithm Beating k-means in 10x Fewer Epochs appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters
items.summary: Zyphra released ZONOS3-Mini, an Apache 2.0 text-to-speech model with 800M total and 100M active parameters. It clones voices, steers delivery word by word and runs in real time in the browser The post Zyphra Releases ZONOS3-Mini: Open-Source TTS With 100M Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, one model with two safeguard levels. Fable 5.2 scores 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, costs $8/$40 per million tokens, and ships with a 1M-token context window. The post Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work
items.summary: Meta Muse Ember is Meta’s smallest model, built for tool calls, coding subtasks and document parsing. It ties Claude Haiku 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at roughly a third of the cost per task. The post Meta Releases Muse Ember, a 1M-Context Model for High-Volume Agent Work appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU
items.summary: Google added TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx to its eighth-generation TPU lineup. TPU 8i Max packs 2 TPU 8i chips per package for long-context agents. TPU 8tx adds hardware confidential inference. Bloomberg reports 2027 availability. The post Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
items.summary: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system that edits code, runs experiments and keeps only verified gains. It beat public bests on NanoChat and NanoGPT Speedrun and sped up ERNIE-5.5-Flash inference. The post Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
items.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server for AI agents. It follows OpenAI’s Pando design and sustained 567 pushes per second on one 8-core server in the company’s own test. The post Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.
